narrative: Golding's Ovid open on the desk, Gib asleep across the right-hand page. The lines under the cat are covered. No face. No hand writing. The same page. The cat has not moved. No words have been copied onto a sheet beside the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked at the covered page and copied nothing.

entities.name: Ovid
entities.context: Shown on book in Gib, on the book
